scope: Corrections to the newly implemented independent reader before its first exact-commit qualification. Frozen scientific inputs and expected outcomes are not relaxed.
review_kind: Same-team AI-assisted author-distinct code/data review and sensitivity probes; not outside human attestation.
prior_failures: Original development collections and failing sensitivity probes remain preserved. Later corrections do not turn those original failed packages into PASS.

corrections.property: Current authority state and closed signed claims
corrections.finding: Early model accepted a stale epoch after sibling revocation, extra signed common claims, or an unknown transition event.
corrections.correction: Reconstruct root epoch and active lineage at each admission/commit; enforce closed claims and transition vocabulary.
corrections.verification: Author-distinct synthetic state probes rejected the same counterexamples after correction and retained a valid positive control.

corrections.finding: Early readback missed changed response reservation/lookup identifiers, an unprescribed exit86, and JSON-only checkpoint substitution.
corrections.correction: Check closed response shapes and request/SQL identities; require the selected actual crash and real SQLite checkpoint files.
corrections.verification: Author-distinct wire/data probes rejected the original substitutions after correction.

corrections.finding: A generic invalid-signature substitution could satisfy an early reader in place of a prescribed role or context experiment.
corrections.correction: Reconstruct frozen requests, exact headers/claims and key-role experiments independently, with mathematical validity under the announced key where required.
corrections.verification: Seven substituted negatives were rejected and the seven prescribed controls accepted by the corrected input reader.

corrections.finding: Early causal readback trusted unmatched commit PID, response indexes or checkpoint placement.
corrections.correction: Correlate producer PID/request/record indexes with raw wire and contiguous coordinator events; anchor checkpoints to actual saved events and lost-reply/restart order.
corrections.verification: Author-distinct copied-evidence probes rejected the altered causal records; valid selected development controls remained semantically accepted before their separate raw-main packaging check.

corrections.finding: A rollback result alone did not establish that the callback reached INSERT before the injected exception.
corrections.correction: Require actual INSERT, arrival and raised records in provider order, tied to the real request, operation, reservation, table and row identifier; require rollback checkpoint before retry.
corrections.verification: The original I18 positive capture passed this causal check; deleting its three activation records was rejected.

corrections.finding: Development checkpoints were valid backups but several final main files still depended on WAL because collection readers remained open.
corrections.correction: Collector closes SQLite handles explicitly and records stopped-writer quiescence. Reader compares immutable final main tables to the final SQLite backup; exporter refuses nonempty WAL.
corrections.verification: Original dependent main files are refused and preserved. Fresh corrected captures must pass before qualification.

corrections.property: Exact corpus inventory and actual SDK matrix
corrections.finding: Directory IDs alone did not prove that history/plan/diagnostic selectors or isolated-fact selectors described the same frozen case.
corrections.correction: Check path, category, selector, mutant witness, synthetic origin and isolated fact together. Check trusted principals and actual SDK role/generation, including the authority-changing actor and crash restart.
corrections.verification: An altered-selector inventory probe is rejected. Full qualification also requires actual loaded-source identities and every frozen matrix member.

corrections.finding: A state violation could precede wire readback, allowing missing captures to go unnoticed by an early activation helper.
corrections.correction: Require the unchanged ordinary semantic rejection plus complete wire/lifecycle/context and structural causal checks, final raw SQL consistency, frozen witness inputs and actual activation records. Missing wire is never DETECTED.
corrections.verification: The copied missing-wire case is refused. The old M02 alpha! implementation remains a failed frozen witness; provider changes to the prescribed bravo mutation, with new-capture verification required.

corrections.finding: An indexed request comparison removed _meta even though exact negative ICT experiments depend on it.
corrections.correction: Compare the complete indexed request to the actual canonical raw request, including metadata, JSON-RPC ID and envelope.
corrections.verification: All 117 retained real development captures pass the full wire comparison separately from their packaging verdict. An altered convenience index must be rejected.

corrections.finding: An early synthetic helper compared SE01 SQL but could accept a restored valid wire token after a self-consistent inventory rehash.
corrections.correction: Compare the prescribed transformation across raw frames/Base64, events, fixtures, observation/manifest views, SQLite tables/schema and unchanged files for all six copies. Inventories alone do not establish the intended delta.
corrections.verification: The original source and failing copied counterexample are preserved. The same restored-wire substitution must be rejected; fresh complete qualification must also pass the positive synthetic controls.

corrections.finding: An early attribution check did not bind the TypeScript archive digest to the preinstall inspection receipt, and SDK names/versions alone did not validate their observed entry-file hashes.
corrections.correction: Link the captured distribution guard to all three artifact hashes and the source manifest; check finalized BUILD source/final source when supplied. Compare SDK entry hashes with data derived from the independently hash-verified pinned upstream archives.
corrections.verification: Qualification requires these linked receipts and official dependency fingerprints. They establish source/data consistency, not external runner authenticity or independent human execution.

qualification_rule: Seal these reader source bytes and this erratum before the candidate campaign. Any later reader correction receives an explicit erratum and a new implementation seal; it does not rewrite frozen expected results or earlier evidence.
